Additionally, machining parameters such as discharge current and pulse duration strongly influence material removal rate, tool wear, and surface roughness, with finer-grained graphite electrodes enhancing process efficiency and reducing wear (Nowicki et al. 2024).
rows.b: Graphite electrodes, particularly those with larger grain sizes, have been shown to increase process efficiency but also exhibit higher relative tool wear, while finer grain graphite provides lower surface roughness in EDM of Hastelloy C-22. The discharge current and pulse duration are the primary parameters influencing material removal rate and surface roughness, with the time interval being critical for electrode wear rate in graphite electrodes (Nowicki et al. 2022)(Nowicki et al. 2024).
